name: Gaping Chasm
summary: In southeastern Tanaris, the Gaping Chasm opens into a Hazzali silithid hive. Its tunnels spread beneath the desert and reveal how far the brood has reached beyond the western sands.

sections.title: The Hive in the Dunes
sections.body: The Gaping Chasm cuts through Tanaris, where tunnels wind among mounds of resin. Beneath the desert, the Hazzali silithid burrow in an aggressive brood. Stingers, swarmers, and hulking sandreavers hunt anyone who descends, traveler or treasure-hunter. The tunnels may trap them in sticky cocoons.

sections.title: A Surveyor's Grave
sections.body: As the hive grew, Gadgetzan grew concerned. Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser sent junior surveyor Scrimshank into the pit to map and measure the geological shifts caused by the insect tunnels. The expedition ended in disaster. Scrimshank died among the chittering broods, leaving scattered gear and measuring instruments as a warning against underestimating the silithid.

faq.q: What creatures dwell inside the Gaping Chasm?
faq.answer: The Hazzali silithid dwell inside the chasm. Their hive holds many castes, including worker drones, winged stingers, swarms, and massive, chitin-plated sandreavers.

faq.q: Where is the Gaping Chasm located?
faq.answer: The Gaping Chasm lies in southeastern Tanaris, south of Gadgetzan and east of the mountain ridge that divides Tanaris from the western wilderness.

faq.q: Why was a gnome surveyor sent into the chasm?
faq.answer: Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser sent Junior Surveyor Scrimshank from Gadgetzan to survey the cavern and assess its geological activity. The Hazzali silithid overwhelmed and killed Scrimshank before he could finish.

faq.q: Are the silithid here related to the ones in other parts of Kalimdor?
aliases: are these silithid connected to silithus
faq.answer: Yes. The Hazzali silithid in Tanaris share the insectoid nature and hive-mind structure of broods in the southern barrens and Silithus to the west. Their presence signals a dangerous, coordinated expansion across southern Kalimdor.

angles.text: As a gnome, remember Junior Surveyor Scrimshank's death in the chasm. Field research in Kalimdor calls for serious firepower as well as scientific curiosity.
As a miner, you may find rich mineral deposits in the hive's exposed clefts and sunken earth. Reaching them means fending off dozens of vicious burrowing insects.
